matched_treatment_minus_control.paired_unit: episode after median of six matched bank deltas

claim_boundary: Descriptive predictor-level mechanism diagnosis on deterministically reconstructed candidate banks for the same eight observed fresh episodes. The prior raw tensors and runtime source revision were not saved, so metric agreement cannot prove bitwise bank or code identity. Oracle interventions and previously failed-bank subsets are descriptive, not causal evidence. This work can prioritize a future hypothesis but cannot establish replacement, CEM viability, closed-loop success, or independent generalization.
